scripts.check:api: uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked mypy && uv run --locked pytest --cov=skifer_board --cov-fail-under=100
scripts.check:docs: uv run --locked python -c "import pathlib,yaml; [yaml.safe_load(p.read_text()) for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.y*ml') if not {'node_modules','.venv'} & set(p.parts)]" && grep -q '^## \[Unreleased\]' CHANGELOG.md
scripts.check: pnpm run check:api && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:e2e && pnpm run check:docs
